results.title: Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia named next IAF Vice Chief
results.content: Air Marshal Walia headed the Directorate of Air Staff Inspection (DASI) of the IAF, served as the defence attache at Indian embassies in Japan and South Korea, and was the Senior Air Staff Officer of Eastern Air Command.

results.title: ACT: India extends winning run, seals spot in the semifinals
results.content: Malaysia also advances to the last-four stage with a third win on the row

results.title: India orders Sun Pharma to halt eye-care drug production at plant after quality lapses
results.content: India’s drug quality standards have come under increased scrutiny at home and overseas in recent years after locally made cough syrups were linked to ‌the deaths of children in India and also in countries including Gambia and Uzbekistan

results.title: India made ‘remarkable progress’ in reducing poverty: World Bank
results.content: Report says the country saw one of the fastest reductions in poverty in the world; extreme poverty fell to 2.6% in 2023 from 27.1% in 2011, driven by government transfers and rising employment

results.title: BJP challenges Rahul Gandhi's claim of curbs on those going to Delhi for protest, demands proof
results.content: BJP MP Sambit Patra takes dig at Congress and its allies for postponing their proposed mock Parliament, claiming it was the result of a lack of organisational capability

results.title: Uttarakhand chopper crash: All six on board killed, says Chamoli District Magistrate
results.content: Five pilgrims from Karnataka and pilot from Delhi killed as helicopter from Badrinath crash amid adverse weather conditions; Congress alleges government negligence and poor safety measures; govt. grounds entire chopper fleet operated by Trans Bharat Aviation; CM orders probe; DGCA and AAIB to reach Dehradun
